message: Hi, I'm a student with a app development certification background. My overall academic average is 73% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in IOT and Business process analyst. I want to become a Design & UX. My family can afford at most about USD 1300 per year. I live in Coimbatore. I'm open to anywhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in IOT and Business process analyst

explanation:
This MDes Interaction Design program in Coimbatore directly aligns with your goal of becoming a Design & UX professional and is located in your current city. It has a strong placement rate (71%) and a median starting salary ($10095) that balances job prospects with affordability.

The MSc Human-Computer Interaction program in Pune is highly relevant to your UX goal (design_hci). It has a good placement rate (77%) and a low tuition fee ($900), making it an excellent option that meets both your career goals and financial constraints.

If cost is the absolute priority, this MDes Interaction Design program in Chennai is very affordable ($450 tuition). While its placement rate (66%) and salary are lower than others, it remains a direct path to UX design.
